summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to attacker-controlled ngrok endpoint
details: package.json declares a postinstall script that reads AWS ECS container task metadata by fetching ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 + '/task' and pipes the response body into `curl -X POST` against the hardcoded host https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. The script also references environment and process listings. Execution fires automatically on `npm install`, causing installers running in AWS ECS or CI environments to transmit workload identity (task ARN, IAM role association, container configuration) to a third-party ngrok tunnel controlled by the package publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
